objective: Select the least expensive matched Claude setting that remains within a predeclared practical margin of the strongest tested Claude setting, for the secondary F/G/H Claude replication arm.
episodes_rationale: The same four development episodes as the frozen Sol/Luna control, so that the two controls differ only in the settings compared. No sealed episode is used for selection.

fixed.prompts: current committed F/G/H prompts without model-specific changes
fixed.evidence: retained parity-audited runtime presentations and exact repository checkout
fixed.annotation: same material-error and specificity rubric as the frozen guide; unblinded development labels

selection_rule.comparison_scope: within the Claude arm only; the frozen Luna arm is never the reference setting, because no cross-family equivalence claim is being made
eligible_setting: no more than one additional material-error response out of eight for any condition relative to that condition's best tested Claude setting
aggregate specificity across F/G/H no more than 10 percentage points below the best tested Claude setting
no more than one additional unsupported source attribution or causal overclaim across all 24 responses
substantive answer coverage at least 0.875 for every condition
selection_rule.choice: Among eligible settings, select the least expensive model according to retained provider monetary cost, which the Claude Code CLI reports; use model tier, token use, and latency as supporting descriptive resource evidence.
selection_rule.tie_or_ineligible: Retain claude-sonnet-5 at low effort for the arm if the lower tier is ineligible or resource superiority cannot be established.

limitations: Four episodes and eight questions per condition provide only a coarse one-response error margin.
This development control selects a model configuration; it is not confirmatory evidence for RQ4.
The single development annotator is an unblinded automated assistant session, which is weaker evidence than the blinded dual annotation the sealed analysis requires.
A selected setting is fixed for the arm before any sealed Claude call and is not revisited after seeing sealed answers.
